Daze.summary: Cloud a creature's mind and possibly stun it.

Dazzling Flash.summary: You raise your religious symbol and create a blinding flash of light.

Death Knell.summary: Finish off a creature who's near death.

Death Ward.summary: Protect a creature against negative energy.

Death's Call.summary: Seeing another pass from this world invigorates you.

Deathless March.summary: You chant a marching song of Yled to empower the undead and terrify the living.

Debilitating Dichotomy.summary: You reveal a glimpse of the impossible conflicts between the divine anathema behind your curse, forcing you to reckon with another's conflicts as well.

Debilitating Terror.summary: You fill the target's mind with terrifying images to disrupt their combat focus.

Deceiver's Cloak.summary: Your patron drapes a cloak of illusion about you, making you appear as another creature of the same body shape with roughly similar height and weight as yourself.

Deep Sight.summary: Your eyes darken until they become entirely pitch black.

Defended By Spirits.summary: You entreat a spirit or the spiritual energies in your location to surround and protect an ally from an certain foe.

Dehydrate.summary: Make creatures parched, damaging and enfeebling them.

Deity's Strike.summary: Enormous deific weapon falls onto a foe from the sky.

Delay Affliction.summary: With a surge of healing energy, you push back against an affliction threatening the target and grant a small amount of healing.

Delay Consequence.summary: You transpose the moment that the target would be injured to a point later in its timestream.

Deluge.summary: You unleash a catastrophic downpour in the area that vanishes an instant later.

Delusional Pride.summary: You make the target overconfident, leading it to ascribe failure to external factors.

Demon Form.summary: Turn into a demon battle form.

Desiccate.summary: Pull moisture from creatures, damaging them.

Desperate Repair.summary: You hold a shield together with the power of your magic, forcing wood and steel to fuse back together.

Destructive Aura.summary: Swirling sands of divine devastation surround you, weakening the defenses of all they touch.

Detect Alignment.summary: See auras of a chosen alignment.

Detect Creator.summary: You examine the remains or spiritual residue of a destroyed undead creature to locate that undead's creator, perhaps a necromancer or vampire.

Detect Poison.summary: Determine whether an object or creature is poisonous or venomous.

Detect Scrying.summary: Find out whether scrying effects are in the area.

Detonate Magic.summary: Cause a spell or item to explode.

Devil Form.summary: Turn into a devil battle form.

Devour Life.summary: You attempt to utterly consume the target's life force.

Devouring Dark Form.summary: Your apparition's dark power blends with your physical body, allowing you to take on terrifying characteristics of creatures that lurk in dark places.

Devouring Void.summary: Countless tears in space appear in the area, like hungry mouths.

Diabolic Edict.summary: You issue a diabolic edict, demanding the target perform a particular task and offering rewards for its fulfillment.

Diadem of Divine Radiance.summary: You don a diadem of radiant light, which sheds bright light to a range of 60 feet and dim light to a further 60 feet.

Diamond Dust.summary: You supercool the nearby air, forming a cloud of dancing ice crystals in an emanation around you.

Dim the Light.summary: You magnify the darkness from the triggering effect, causing the ambient light level to flicker briefly so you can slip from sight.

Dimensional Anchor.summary: Keep a creature from teleporting or traveling to other planes.

Dimensional Assault.summary: You tumble through a small rift in space itself, making a short dimensional hop to better position yourself for a devastating surprise attack.

Dimensional Excision.summary: You manipulate the boundaries between planes like a scalpel, using it to cut away portions of a creature's essence and banishing those portions to other realities and dimensions, afflicting the target deep lacerations or even severed...

Dinosaur Fort.summary: You conjure a primeval fort with walls of sharpened wood adorned with dinosaur skin and teeth, up to 300 feet on a side.

Dirge of Doom.summary: Enemies within the area are frightened 1.

Dirge of Remembrance.summary: You sing a funereal dirge to force restless spirits to fully manifest in the Material Plane.

Disappearance.summary: Make a creature invisible, silent, and undetectable by special senses.

Discern Location.summary: Discover a target's exact location within unlimited range.

Discern Secrets.summary: Your patron deigns to whisper a few secrets.

Discomfiting Whisper.summary: You are surrounded by an aura of spiteful murmurings that incite bad luck and punish failure.

Disguise Magic.summary: Mask the aura of a spell or item.

Disintegrate.summary: Reduce a creature or object to dust.

Disjunction.summary: Deactivate or destroy a magic item.

Dispel Magic.summary: End a spell or suppress an item's magic.

Dispelling Globe.summary: Counteract magic that enters this sphere.

Disperse into Air.summary: After taking the triggering damage, you transform into air.

Disrupting Weapons.summary: Weapons deal positive damage to undead.

Disruptive Transfer.summary: Using Venorium Blorm's formulas, you calculate a path through space.

Distortion Lens.summary: You create a magical lens that distorts space as best suits you.

Distracting Chatter.summary: Distract a creature with auditory illusions.

Distracting Decoy.summary: You conjure a colorful, fast-moving shape, such as a small bird or other animal that draws your target's eye.

Dividing Trench.summary: You dig an earthen trench across the surrounding terrain, which must be soil, clay, sand, or other soft earth, but not flooring or stone.

Divine Armageddon.summary: Call on your deity to bring about a cataclysm.

Divine Aura.summary: Allies in an aura have better defenses and are protected against one alignment.

Divine Decree.summary: Creatures opposing your deity's will are damaged, enfeebled, or banished.

Divine Dragon's Watch.summary: You summon an invisible divine draconic spirit to watch over your target.

Divine Immolation.summary: Call divine fire from the sky.

Divine Inspiration.summary: Spiritual energy recovers a creature's expended spell.

Divine Lance.summary: Throw divine energy that deals spirit damage.

Divine Vessel.summary: Take on aspects of a servitor of your deity.

Divine Wrath.summary: Damage and hinder creatures opposing your deity's will.

Diviner's Sight.summary: You glimpse into the target's future.

Divinity Leech.summary: You disrupt the connection between a divine caster or deific servitor and their deity, blocking their use of divine power.

Dizzying Colors.summary: Swirling colors blind, dazzle, or stun creatures.

Dominate.summary: A creature must obey your orders.

Domora's Defense.summary: When you Cast this Spell, a watery replica of the eidolon Dyzad appears in front of each of the targets.

Door to Beyond.summary: Striking at thin air, you create hairline cracks in an unoccupied adjacent space that lead somewhere outside reality.

Downpour.summary: You call forth a torrential downpour, which extinguishes non-magical flames.

Draconic Barrage.summary: You shape energy into a small group of tiny dragons (or other serpentine creatures) that flit around you.

Dragon Breath.summary: You spew energy from your mouth, dealing 5d6 damage with a basic Reflex save.

Dragon Claws.summary: Vicious claws grow from your fingers.

Dragon Turret.summary: You conjure forth a massive tower with a large dragon that's bound to crawl its length.

Dragon Wings.summary: Leathery wings sprout from your back, giving you a fly Speed of 60 feet or your Speed, whichever is faster.

Drain Life.summary: You close your hand and pull life energy from another creature into yourself.

Draw Ire.summary: Mentally sting a creature's mind to make it less capable of attacking creatures other than you.

Draw Moisture.summary: Dry out an object and collect the water.

Draw the Lightning.summary: Call down lightning into you or a weapon.

Dread Aura.summary: You emit an aura of terror.

Dread Secret.summary: You utter a powerful secret at odds with the fundamental nature of the target creatures.

Dream Message.summary: Send a message that arrives in a dream.

Dreamer's Call.summary: You create a vivid, illusory daydream drawn from the images of the target's dreams.

Dreaming Potential.summary: The target retrains in its dreams.

Drop Dead.summary: The target appears to die, but turns invisible.

Dull Ambition.summary: Curse a creature with a lack of ambition.

Duplicate Foe.summary: Create a temporary duplicate of an enemy to fight for you.

Dust Storm.summary: You call forth a swirling storm of dust.

Dutiful Challenge.summary: As you challenge an enemy, you take some of its attention away from your allies.

D\u00e9j\u00e0 Vu.summary: Make a creature do the same thing repeatedly.

Eagle's Cry.summary: You let out the mighty cry of a majestic eagle that pierces eardrums.

Earth and Sky.summary: You erupt into the air with the force of a dragon taking flight, launching nearby creatures into the sky with you.

Earth's Bile.summary: Your apparition is the will of lava and magma made manifest, the earth's molten blood unleashing devastating bursts of liquid stone and unquenchable fire at your command.

Earthbind.summary: Bring a flying creature to the ground.

Earthquake.summary: Shake the ground with a devastating earthquake.

Earthworks.summary: With a ripple of earth, you raise small barriers from the ground.

Eat Fire.summary: React to eat flame then belch the smoke out.

Echo Jump.summary: You teleport to an unoccupied space within range, leaving behind a faint echo of your form that explodes with magical force.

Echoing Weapon.summary: Your attacks build up to release a sonic pulse.

Eclipse Burst.summary: Explode a globe of darkness that deals cold damage, hurts the living, and overcomes light.

Ectoplasmic Expulsion.summary: You call upon tendrils of ephemeral ectoplasm to pass through the target and carry away a harmful psychic affliction.

Ectoplasmic Interstice.summary: You force the mortal Universe and Ethereal Planes to partially merge, creating a zone that causes incorporeal and spiritual entities to take on many of the aspects of corporeal creatures.

Efficient Apport.summary: Walking over to an item to pick it up is so much effort.

Eidolon's Wrath.summary: Your eidolon releases a powerful explosion of energy that deals 5d6 damage of the type you chose when you took the Eidolon's Wrath feat, with a basic Reflex save.

Eject Soul.summary: Your touch disrupts the connection between body and soul, possibly forcing the soul out of the body altogether.

Electric Arc.summary: Zap one or two creatures with lightning.

Electrified Crystal Ward.summary: You create an electric latch rune hazard on the target, creating a special crystalline lock on the object.

Elemental Absorption.summary: Resist elemental effects and then release the energy against a foe.

Elemental Annihilation Wave.summary: Draw in elemental energy to unleash a cone of burning destruction.

Elemental Betrayal.summary: Your patron uses its superior command of the elements, empowering them to undermine your foe.

Elemental Blast.summary: You gather elemental energy and blast your foes in one of the various listed shapes of your choosing, dealing 8d6 damage.

Elemental Confluence.summary: Summon a confluence of four elementals.

Elemental Counter.summary: Use a countering element to protect against a spell.

Elemental Gift.summary: Infuse an ally with one of the four elements.

Elemental Motion.summary: You call upon your element to propel you, improving your Speed depending on your element.

Elemental Sense.summary: Gain a sense related to an element you choose.

Elemental Sheath.summary: You coat yourself in nature's power.

Elemental Tempest.summary: Your spellcasting surrounds you in a storm of elemental energy.

Elemental Toss.summary: With a flick of your wrist, you fling a chunk of your elemental matter at your foe.

Elemental Zone.summary: Make one element more damaging in a zone.

Elephant Form.summary: You channel the primal forces of nature to transform into a Large battle form, specifically that of a powerful and terrifying elephant or similar creature, such as a mammoth, mastodon, or anancus.

Elysian Whimsy.summary: You overwhelm the target with an unexpected and unpredictable desire if it fails a Will save.

Embed Message.summary: Leave an illusory message to be triggered at a later date.

Embodiment of Battle.summary: Your apparition guides your attacks and imparts its skill to your movements.

Embrace Nothingness.summary: You empty your body of substance, becoming one with nothingness.

Embrace the Pit.summary: Devil horns grow from your skull, and your skin takes on features of the devil responsible for your diabolic bloodline.

Empathic Link.summary: You forge a bond between yourself and the target, enabling you to feel each other's emotions.

Empty Body.summary: You turn ethereal, with the effects of ethereal jaunt, but you don't need to concentrate.

Empty Inside.summary: You inject a sliver of the void into your mind, momentarily remaking it into a bleak and empty place.

Empty Pack.summary: You render every item inside the container you touch invisible, although the container itself remains visible.

Endure.summary: You invigorate the touched creature's mind and urge it to press on.

Endure Elements.summary: Protect a creature from severe cold or heat.

Enduring Might.summary: Your own might mingles with divine power to protect you from harm.

Energy Absorption.summary: You're used to mitigating the damage done by bombs, siege engines, and magical artillery.

Energy Aegis.summary: A creature gains resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality and void damage.

Enhance Victuals.summary: Improve food or drink and remove poisons.

Enlarge.summary: Cause a creature to grow in size.

Enlarge Companion.summary: Your animal companion grows much larger, towering over its foes in battle.

Entangle.summary: Plants and fungi in an area grow to entangle and immobilize.

Entangle Fate.summary: You cause a swirl of energy to entangle the fates of all caught within the blast.

Entangling Flora.summary: Sprout plants to hinder movement in an area.

Enthrall.summary: Your speech makes creatures fascinated with you.

Entrancing Eyes.summary: Your eyes glow with an entrancing radiance that captivates those who meet your gaze.

Entreat Spirit.summary: You invite a spirit you've bonded with to bolster your mind.

Entreat the Many.summary: You manifest echoes of all the spirits you've ever bonded with at once, in a spiraling cyclone of colorful forms.

Entropic Wheel.summary: You stockpile thermal energy in a magical wheel-like construct that lets you burn opponents with cold or freeze their bodies with heat.

Entwined Roots.summary: Protect creatures with durable roots that can catch ranged weapons.

Environmental Endurance.summary: Protect a creature from severe cold or heat.

Ephemeral Hazards.summary: You create illusory hazards, such as spinning blades or a puddle of acid, in four 10-foot-by-10-foot spaces within range.

Ephemeral Tracking.summary: You can look at currents in the air and water and see tracks that you can follow just as you would on land.

Equal Footing.summary: You level the field between yourself and another creature, hampering its movements if it's quicker than you.

Eradicate Undeath.summary: A massive deluge of life energy causes the undead to fall apart.

Erase Trail.summary: You drastically reduce all signs of one specific creature's passage from the area, including footprints, handprints, dirt, and minor changes caused to the surrounding environment, like the bending of grass.

Establish Ward.summary: You bind a part of your essence to your surroundings, creating a warded area that grants you power within it, but drains you outside of it.

Ethereal Jaunt.summary: Use the Ethereal Plane to move through objects and into the air.

Etheric Shards.summary: You reach out and sow glittering splinters of force throughout the area, otherworldly caltrops of will and ectoplasm.

Euphoric Renewal.summary: You view death not as an ending but a beginning, and you delight in dancing on its edge.

Everlight.summary: Cause a gem to glow eternally.

Evil Eye.summary: Your patron's resentment manifests in a baleful, envious gaze.

Evolution Surge.summary: You flood your eidolon with power, creating a temporary evolution in your eidolon's capabilities.

Excise Lexicon.summary: You reach into a creature's mind and extract its knowledge of a word.

Execute.summary: Pull a living creature toward death or an undead creature toward destruction.

Expeditious Excavation.summary: You remove loose dirt, dust, gravel, sand, and the like (though not solid stone) up to the size of a 5-foot cube.

Exploding Earth.summary: Throw an exploding ball of earth.

Explosive Barrage.summary: You fire a booming, fiery explosion followed by a salvo of smaller blasts, each cracking the air with the sound of thunder.

Extend Blood Magic.summary: You call upon the arcane energy coursing through your blood to extend the magic it grants.

Extend Boost.summary: You focus on the intricacies of the magic binding you to your eidolon to extend the duration of your boost eidolon or reinforce eidolon spell.

Extend Spell.summary: You call upon your blood's knowledge of the ancients to extend your magic.

Extract Poison.summary: Draw out poison from an object and make your next attack poisonous.

Eyes of the Dead.summary: You enter a magical trance that allows you to perceive through the senses of the target creature.

Fabricated Truth.summary: Make creatures believe something is factual.

Face in the Crowd.summary: While in a crowd of roughly similar creatures, your appearance becomes bland and nondescript.

Faerie Dust.summary: You sprinkle magical dust in the spell's area, making those within easier to trick.

Faerie Fire.summary: Colorful light prevents creatures from being concealed or invisible.

Fallen Soldier's Lament.summary: You raise an illusion in the space of a fallen foe, crafting it to resemble a ghost of your target before parading it across the battlefield.

Falling Sky.summary: Extraordinary telekinetic pressure smashes down through the area, battering creatures within it to the ground.

Falling Stars.summary: Call down four pieces of the heavens to deal bludgeoning and elemental damage.

Fallow Field.summary: A sickly yellow light fills the area as entropic forces prevent healing.

False Nature.summary: You create an illusion that makes an object seem to be something entirely different.

Falsify Heat.summary: Make a creature's body heat seem different.

Familiar Form.summary: You transform into a Tiny animal that commonly serves as a spellcaster's familiar.

Familiar's Face.summary: Implant your senses in your animal companion or familiar.

Familiar\u2019s Face.summary: Implant your senses and voice in your companion.

Far Sight.summary: You can see distant objects as if they were closer.

Far-Flung Fetch.summary: You can pilfer an object even if it's outside the reach of your fingers.

Fashionista.summary: The target's clothes are transformed into ostentatious attire that epitomizes high-end local fashion.

Fatal Aria.summary: You perform music so perfect that the target may die of joy or sorrow.

Fate's Travels.summary: You get a vision of the creature when it was alive, and its last 10 minutes of travel.

Fated Confrontation.summary: Isolate two fated opponents and let them twist each other's fate.

Fated Healing.summary: You speak about the consequences of actions people take against each other and how it's possible to break cycles of violence simply by making a different choice.

Fateful Condemnation.summary: You draw upon the target's negative fate, causing this lingering destiny to afflict it and its nearby allies with the unintended consequences of its past lives.

Favorable Review.summary: You enchant a creature to ensure they have only good things to say about your show.

Fear.summary: Frighten a creature, possibly making it flee.

Fear the Sun.summary: You cause the creature's vision to become particularly sensitive.

Fearful Feast.summary: You open your mouth wide and inhale sharply; you draw in the bravery, self-confidence, and hope to which the frightened target clings and then strip away the target's false assumption that these fragile emotions can save them from the...

Feast of Ashes.summary: You curse the target with a hunger no food can sate.

Feather Fall.summary: React to slow a creature's fall.

Feet to Fins.summary: Turn a creature's feet into fins, enabling it to swim but slowing it on land.

Feral Shades.summary: A cone of hound-shaped shades tear creatures apart.

Fey Disappearance.summary: You become invisible and ignore natural difficult terrain (such as underbrush).

Fey Form.summary: Turn into a fey battle form.

Fey Glamour.summary: You call upon fey glamours to cloak an area or the targets in illusion.

Field of Life.summary: Create a vital energy field that heals those who remain within.

Field of Razors.summary: Fill an area with a tangle of razor wire.

Fiery Body.summary: Turn your body into living flame.

Figment.summary: Create a simple auditory or visual illusion.

Filter Air.summary: You suck in a rough breath of air, and your body automatically filters out the harmful molecules that would infest your lungs.

Final Fate of The Locust Host.summary: You conjure the rotting corpse of Deskari, previously Lord of the Locust Hosts, to the battlefield.

Final Sacrifice.summary: Channel energy to blow up your minion.

Finger of Death.summary: Point at a creature to deal negative damage and possibly kill it instantly.

Fire Ray.summary: A blazing band of fire arcs through the air, lighting your opponent and the ground they stand upon on fire.

Fire Shield.summary: You create a hovering shield made of fire.

Fireball.summary: An explosion of fire in an area burns creatures.

Fireproof.summary: Protect an object against catching fire.

Firework Blast.summary: You create a massive display of loud and colorful explosions.

Flame Dancer.summary: Encircle a creature in flames to inflame its strikes and give it an intimidating dance.

Flame Strike.summary: Call divine fire from the sky.

Flame Vortex.summary: Invoke a moving tornado of fire and wind.

Flame Wisp.summary: Fire wisps damage those you strike, and more grow if you cast fire spells.

Flames of Ego.summary: Light up a creature and make it fascinated with itself.

Flaming Fusillade.summary: You call upon an endless barrage of flames, a series of explosions bursting around you like miniature suns.

Flaming Sphere.summary: A ball of fire rolls about at your command.

Flammable Fumes.summary: Conjure poisonous fumes that can explode in flame.

Flashy Disappearance.summary: You create a puff of colorful smoke that quickly disperses while you become temporarily invisible.

Flense.summary: With a touch, you strip off the flesh, muscle, and internal organs off your target, leaving only bare bones.

Flesh to Stone.summary: Turn a living creature into a stone statue.

Flicker.summary: Protect yourself from most damage as you teleport erratically.

Floating Disk.summary: A disk of energy follows you, carrying objects.

Floating Flame.summary: Summoned fire moves at your command.

Flourishing Flora.summary: Grow a patch of cacti, flowers, fruits, or roots to hurt your enemies.

Flowing Strike.summary: Flow on a wave and attack on the way.

Flurry of Claws.summary: Vicious dragon claws appear and slash at two nearby foes.

Fly.summary: Grant the target a fly Speed.

Focusing Hum.summary: You infuse the air around you with a sustained hum that allows creatures within it to resist distractions.

Fold Metal.summary: Bend a metal object into a ball.

Font of Serenity.summary: A divine beacon radiates serenity, soothing nearby allies.

For Love, For Lightning.summary: When you Cast the Spell, you plunge the required weapon into the ground, where it crackles with crimson lightning.

Foraging Friends.summary: Giving a cheerful whistle, you call forth a handful of small animals, such as birds or mice, to collect food for you and your allies.

Forbidden Thought.summary: You place a psychic lock in a foe's mind that prevents it from a specific action.

Forbidding Ward.summary: Protect an ally against one specific enemy.

Force Barrage.summary: Pelt creatures with unerring shards of magical force.

Force Bolt.summary: You fire an arrow-shaped bolt of force, one of the most common and reliable forms of battle magic.

Force Cage.summary: Form a prison of pure magical force.

Force Fang.summary: You briefly transform your attack into pure force energy to bypass your opponent's defenses.

Forced Mercy.summary: You soften the target's blows, ensuring they avoid vital areas and cause no lasting harm.

Forced Quiet.summary: You quiet the target's voice, preventing it from giving away valuable secrets.

Forceful Hand.summary: Create a hand of force that can interpose to defend you or attack if heightened.

Foresee the Path.summary: You see just a split second into the future and glean how an enemy will move.

Foresight.summary: Danger sense warns you when a creature is in danger and protects it with good fortune.

Forest of Gates.summary: You transport yourself and your allies to a peaceful extraplanar realm of towering trees, each of which holds a misty gateway to another location.

Forge.summary: Developed before the introduction of the Iron Lagoon, this cantrip for superheating metal has also found valuable combat use.

Fortify Summoning.summary: As you call a creature to your side, your magic transforms its body, heightening its ferocity and fortifying its resilience.

Fortissimo Composition.summary: You call upon your muse to greatly increase the benefits you provide with your courageous anthem, rallying anthem, or song of strength composition.

Foul Miasma.summary: You multiply the disease within a creature, drawing it into an infectious mist outside their body where it can spread to other creatures.

Freedom of Movement.summary: A creature overcomes hindrances to its movement.

Freeze Time.summary: Briefly stop time for everything but you.

Freezing Rain.summary: Chill and slow creatures with cold rain.

Frenzied Revelry.summary: You recall memories of hedonistic rites to send yourself into an infectious frenzy, dancing and howling wildly to encourage your companions to join in.

Friendfetch.summary: You shoot out ephemeral, telekinetic strands that drag each target directly toward you, stopping in the closest unoccupied space to you in this path.

Friendly Push.summary: You exert magical force to propel a willing creature up to 10 feet in a straight line, including upward, though if they aren't on solid ground or have another way to maintain their height (such as a fly Speed) when the movement ends, they...

Frigid Flurry.summary: Turn into slashing snow and fly in a straight line.

Frog Tongue.summary: Your tongue extends unnaturally, flicking out toward a creature within range and dealing bludgeoning damage.

Frost Pillar.summary: Freeze a creature in a pillar of ice.

Frost's Touch.summary: Your gelid shard drinks down nearby heat in a futile attempt to sate itself and achieve a level of frigid cold unheard of on the Material Plane.

Frostbite.summary: Damage a creature with bitter cold.

Frozen Fog.summary: You conjure a chilling mist that settles into the bones and makes it difficult to move.

Funeral Flames.summary: You transform a bludgeon into a fearsome torch suited to casting undead into the afterlife.

Fungal Exhalation.summary: You exhale toxic mold spores that fill the area.

Fungal Hyphae.summary: Thin hyphae grow from your feet and plunge into the earth, creating a symbiotic fungal network that attaches to plants within 30 feet and connects you to their root systems.

Fungal Infestation.summary: Plant poisonous fungal growths in a creature.

Gale Blast.summary: Damage and push adjacent creatures with air.

Garden Of The Green Man's Growth.summary: You cast your magic into the earth, calling out to a powerful green man, a verdant lesser deity of nature, to come to your aid.

Garden of Healing.summary: Spirits of comfort and respite swirl around you, trailing visions of growing grass and blooming blossoms.

Gaseous Form.summary: Turn a willing creature into a flying cloud.

Gasping Marsh.summary: With a rattling hiss, you create a quickly evaporating mist of invisible poisonous marsh gas to smother creatures in the area.

Gate.summary: Tear open a portal to another plane.

Gecko Grip.summary: Give a creature a climb Speed.

Genie's Veil.summary: With a flourish, you fulfill a creature's wish for protection, bending reality to keep them from harm.

Gentle Breeze.summary: Create a soothing wind that heals and reduces heat.

Gentle Landing.summary: React to save a falling creature.

Gentle Repose.summary: A corpse doesn't decay and can't become undead.

Geyser.summary: Blast foes upward with superheated water, causing them to fall and leaving concealing fog.

Ghostly Carrier.summary: Create a semicorporeal figure that carries your touch spells to targets.

Ghostly Shift.summary: Your body becomes insubstantial as you partially phase out.

Ghostly Tragedy.summary: Have spirits re-enact a violent event.

Ghostly Transcription.summary: Glowing letters assemble in the air, providing a transcription of the target's speech in all languages you speak.

Ghostly Weapon.summary: Make a weapon affect incorporeal creatures.

Ghoulish Cravings.summary: Afflict a creature with a craving for raw meat.

Gift of the Anemos.summary: Your apparition envelops you in gusting winds that can speed your steps or buffet your foes.

Girzanje's March.summary: You sing a prayer for war, inspiring valor in allies who hear your song.

Glacial Heart.summary: Ice and bone-deep cold assail the target, freezing it from the inside out.

Glamorize.summary: Using simple magical gestures, you alter a minor detail of your appearance.

Glass Form.summary: Turn a creature's body into living glass.

Glass Sand.summary: You throw a handful of sand that transforms into jagged shards of glass.

Glass Shield.summary: Protect yourself with a glass shield.

Glimmer of Charm.summary: Briefly improve the attitude of nearby creatures with a charming aura.

Glimpse Weakness.summary: You glimpse a loose scale, a seam in a foe's armor, or a similar weakness, aiding your allies in landing a precise hit.

Glimpse the Truth.summary: Divine insight lets you see things as they are, unveiled by attempts to magically cloak the truth.

Glitterdust.summary: Sparkling dust breaks invisibility and impedes vision.

Globe of Invulnerability.summary: Magical sphere counteracts spells that would enter it.

Glowing Trail.summary: Your movements leave a vague glowing path behind you, like a misty echo of your presence.

Glutton's Jaw.summary: Your mouth transforms into a shadowy maw bristling with pointed teeth.

Glutton's Jaws.summary: A slavering maw opens beneath a target and tries to take a bite out of them.

Gluttonous Growth.summary: Plants in the area grow rapidly, taking on carnivorous characteristics as they seek to consume prey.

Glyph of Warding.summary: Store a spell in a symbol to make a trap.

Goblin Pox.summary: Infect a creature with goblin pox.

Goodberry.summary: You imbue the target berry with the bounty of nature, allowing it to heal and sustain far beyond its normal capacity.

Gouging Claw.summary: Morph your limb into a claw and attack with it.

Grasp of the Deep.summary: Make a creature feel like it's being crushed underwater.

Grasping Earth.summary: Create hands of rock from the ground to grab creatures.

Grasping Grave.summary: Hundreds of skeletal arms erupt from the ground in the area, clawing at creatures within and attempting to hold them in place.

Grasping Vine.summary: A thick, curling vine erupts from the ground beneath you and stretches to the target, allowing you to move it around.

Grave Impressions.summary: You project a fragment of your senses into the corpse.

Gravitational Pull.summary: Pull one or more creatures toward you.

Gravity Weapon.summary: You build up gravitational force and funnel it into your blows, leading to more powerful attacks with blade and bow alike.

Gravity Well.summary: Pull all creatures towards the center of a sphere of altered gravity.

Gray Shadow.summary: You pray over a dying creature, drawing its shadow into your service as long as its owner is stooped at death's door.

Grease.summary: Cover a target or an area with slippery grease.

Grim Tendrils.summary: Creatures in a line take void damage and start to bleed.

Grisly Growths.summary: A creature grows sickening limbs and organs.

Gritty Wheeze.summary: You exhale desiccating grit and sand in a small cloud.

Guided Introspection.summary: You guide the target in examining their innermost feelings, their behaviors, and the motivations behind their actions, granting them clarity and insight.

Guiding Star.summary: Constellations nudge the target to travel to a location you choose.

Gust of Wind.summary: Wind blows out fires and knocks back objects and creatures.

Hag's Fruit.summary: You imbue a single piece of fruit with a curse that leaves its victims in a magical sleep.

Halcyon Infusion.summary: You infuse magical energy into your target, opening up their mind to the pathways of magic and granting them the ability to use magic to affect the world around them.

Halcyon Mists.summary: In a moment of dire need, you call upon ancestral power to strengthen and sustain.

Hallowed Ground.summary: One small space becomes inhospitable to undead as you fill it with life-infused benevolent magic.

Hallucination.summary: Cause a creature to believe one thing is another, to notice something that isn't there, or to be unable to detect something.

Hallucinatory Terrain.summary: A natural environment appears to be another kind of terrain.

Hand of the Apprentice.summary: You take advantage of one of the most fundamental lessons of magic to levitate and propel your weapon.

Harm.summary: Void energy harms the living or heals the undead, either a single creature or all in a burst.

Harmonize Self.summary: You heal yourself in one of the following ways, chosen by you when you cast the spell.

Haste.summary: Speed up a creature so it can attack or move more often.

Hasted Assault.summary: You call upon your magic to speed up your attacks.

Haunting Hymn.summary: A powerful hymn harms and deafens.

Heal.summary: Vital energy heals the living or harms the undead, either a single creature or all in a burst.

Heal Animal.summary: You heal an animal's wounds, restoring 1d8 Hit Points to the target.

Heal Companion.summary: You heal your animal companion's wounds.

Healer's Blessing.summary: Your words bless a creature with an enhanced connection to vital energy.

Healing Plaster.summary: Transform mud into a healing plaster to treat wounds without healer's tools.

Healing Well.summary: Create a well that you and your allies can use to heal.

Heart's Desire.summary: You surround your target with wondrous illusions of their greatest desires, which distract them from reality.

Heart's Hook.summary: You drive two creatures toward a fated meeting

Heaving Earth.summary: Make a shockwave that pushes creatures in the way and explodes when it reaches a target.

Hedge Prison.summary: You conjure an intricate hedge prison to trap a creature, encasing them completely in a hollow cube of dense bushes.

Heinous Future.summary: You hold up fractured mirror to the target, and in that mirror it sees a thing that may yet come to pass.

Hellfire Plume.summary: You call forth a plume of hellfire that erupts from below

Helpful Reload.summary: With a quick gesture, you reload your ally's weapon, allowing them to focus on fighting the enemy.

Helpful Steps.summary: You call forth a ladder or staircase to help you reach greater heights.

Helpful Wood Spirits.summary: Make a gaggle of wood spirits carry out a small task.

Hero's Defiance.summary: You shout in defiance and are filled with a burst of healing.

Heroic Feat.summary: You gain the ability to perform a specialized combat technique from the vast wealth of martial knowledge your mystery provides.

Heroism.summary: Stoke a creature's inner heroism to make it more competent.

Hidden Mind.summary: Protect a creature from mental magic and effects that pry into its secrets.

Hidebound.summary: The target's skin erupts in thick hide or dense scales.

Hideous Laughter.summary: Fits of laughter make a creature unable to take all its actions.

Hippocampus Retreat.summary: You temporarily shape your lower limbs into the tail of a hippocampus in order to swim away from a nearby foe after dealing a parting blow.

Hollow Heart.summary: You stoke the target's ambition beyond reason, until it believes no one is capable of helping it.

Hologram Cage.summary: You weave light into a cube of vivid and fantastic patterns.

Holy Cascade.summary: Make an explosion of holy water.

Holy Host.summary: In stories, armies with just and righteous causes win with little difficulty, conquering unholy legions.

Holy Light.summary: A ray of burning light deals extra damage to fiends and other unholy creatures.

Honeyed Words.summary: Make even the most unlikely lies more believable.

Horde of Underlings.summary: You summon six underlings, such as skeletons or kobolds.

Horrid Wilting.summary: Pull moisture from creatures, damaging them.

Horrific Visage.summary: You briefly transform your features into the horrific visage of a hag, striking fear into your enemies.

Horrifying Blood Loss.summary: You curse the target, filling it with terror at the loss of its blood.

House of Imaginary Walls.summary: You mime an invisible 10-foot-by-10-foot wall adjacent to you and within your reach.

Howling Blizzard.summary: Fill a cone or burst with cold winds and snowdrifts.

Humanoid Form.summary: Take the shape of a humanoid.

Hungry Depths.summary: Open a door to corrupted water that damages and consumes.

Hunter's Luck.summary: You have a preternatural ability to remember details about your foes.

Hunter's Vision.summary: Your target glows with a magical aura visible only to you and those who follow your lead.

Hurtling Stone.summary: You evoke a magical stone and throw it, with divine guide to your aim.

Hydraulic Push.summary: Damage and push a creature with a blast of water.

Hydraulic Torrent.summary: Force creatures back with a damaging line of water.

Hymn of Healing.summary: Your glorious singing mends wounds and provides a temporary respite from harm.

Hypercognition.summary: Recall massive amounts of information in an instant.

Hyperfocus.summary: You sharpen a creature's senses, though more distant objects become hazy, indistinct, or muted to it.

Hypnotic Pattern.summary: Shifting colors dazzle and fascinate creatures.

Hypnotize.summary: Shifting colors dazzle and fascinate creatures.

Ice Storm.summary: Call a storm cloud that pelts creatures with hail.

Ignite Ambition.summary: You strengthen the target's ambition, increase its resentment of its allies, and make its allegiances more susceptible to change.

Ignition.summary: Burn a creature up close or at range.

Illuminate.summary: Kindle all light sources around you.

Illusory Creature.summary: Form a convincing illusion of a creature.

Illusory Disguise.summary: Make yourself look like a different creature.

Illusory Object.summary: Form a convincing illusion of an object.

Illusory Scene.summary: Create an imaginary scene containing multiple creatures and objects.

Illusory Shroud.summary: You shroud the target in subtle illusions that make it difficult to detect.

Imaginary Lockbox.summary: Hide items in a mental compartment.

Imaginary Weapon.summary: You create a simple weapon of force and lash out, its arc following your hand.

Impaling Spike.summary: Skewer a creature with a cold iron spike.

Impeccable Flow.summary: You attune yourself to an underlying cosmic order to the world.

Implement of Destruction.summary: You solemnly declare that the target weapon will bring death to a foe.

Implosion.summary: Make a creature collapse in on itself.

Imprint Message.summary: Put a false psychic imprint in an object.

Incendiary Ashes.summary: A cloud of magical ashes descends upon creatures in the area.

Indolent Haze.summary: The faint scent of poppies and a soothing calm fill the area, urging creatures to lay down and take a rest.

Inevitable Disaster.summary: Twist fate to damage a foe in the near future.

Infectious Enthusiasm.summary: You and an ally are both encouraged to improve one roll.

Infectious Melody.summary: An infectious tune makes creatures sing along.

Infiltrator's Tunnel.summary: It's best to know the ingress and egress points for any location you plan to rob.

Information Overload.summary: You call on Cobyslarni to open the target's mind to knowledge - too much knowledge

Infuse Vitality.summary: Empower attacks with vital energy to damage the undead.

Inkshot.summary: A spray of viscous, toxic ink jets from your fingertip to strike a target creature in the face.

Inner Radiance Torrent.summary: Gather spiritual energy to fire a storm of force bolts and beams.

Inner Upheaval.summary: You focus your qi into devastating magical attacks.

Inscrutable Mask.summary: You shroud your form and features in an impenetrable mask of shadow.

Insect Form.summary: Turn into a dangerous giant insect.

Inside Ropes.summary: You pull a large handful of guts from your midsection.

Inspire Competence.summary: Your encouragement inspires your ally to succeed at a task.

Inspire Courage.summary: You inspire your allies with words or tunes of encouragement.

Inspire Defense.summary: You inspire your allies to protect themselves more effectively.

Inspire Heroics.summary: You call upon your muse to greatly increase the benefits you provide to your allies with your inspire courage or inspire defense composition.

Instant Minefield.summary: You create several hidden mines throughout the area that explode when stepped on.

Instant Parade.summary: An illusory parade with dozens of participants and performers appears around you, following you as you move.

Interplanar Teleport.summary: Transport creatures to another plane in the Multiverse.

Interposing Earth.summary: React to make a barrier of earth.

Interstellar Void.summary: You call upon the frigid depths of outer space to bring a terrible chill to your enemy.

Invisibility.summary: A creature can't be seen until it attacks.

Invoke True Name.summary: You speak the true name of a creature to more surely affect it with your magic.

Invoke the Crimson Oath.summary: Unleash a blast of ruby light, striking all before you.

Iron Gut.summary: Your mouth, esophagus, and stomach become incredibly elastic and tougher than metal.

Isolation.summary: You summon a tangible manifestation of loneliness to cloak the target from view as surely as if it were wreathed in darkness.

It Is Written.summary: You envision a future for yourself, confident in the certainty that this vision is your destiny.

Item Facade.summary: Disguise an item to look perfect or shoddy.

Jassim's Allegiance.summary: You bartered for this spell in some strange market or perhaps gained it while wandering the desert, hopelessly lost and surrounded by nothing but the remnants of time and fallen empires.

Jealous Hex.summary: You draw forth a hag's innate jealousy to deny a target its greatest attribute.

Join Pasts.summary: Share thoughts and experiences with allies.

Juvenile Companion.summary: Turn your companion into its juvenile form.

Keen Smell.summary: Your nose becomes more sensitive to the scents of the wild, the better for you to track your quarry.

Kgalaserke's Axes.summary: The folklore and tales surrounding the legendary hero Kgalaserke are so widespread and well known that a hundred lifetimes would not be enough to have accomplished everything she is reputed to have done.

Ki Cutting Sight.summary: Ki flows through everything. Strike at just the right place with dire consequences

Ki Form.summary: Drawing from deep wells of spiritual power, you take on a special ki form.

Ki Rush.summary: Accelerated by your ki, you move with such speed you become a blur.

Ki Strike.summary: You focus your ki into magical attacks.

Kinetic Ram.summary: Gathering kinetic energy, you either focus it in a straight line or disperse it as an encircling ripple.

King's Castle.summary: You and a willing creature swap places.

Knock.summary: Make a door, lock, or container easier to open, and possibly open it immediately.

Know Location.summary: You create an invisible anchor at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect), as long as you can identify the location by its appearance (or other identifying features).

Know the Enemy.summary: You quickly remind yourself of useful information.

Know the Way.summary: Learn true north and the direction to another location.

Lament.summary: You let out your negative emotions in a guttural wail that shakes your enemies' hearts and deals 1d8 mental damage (basic Will save) to each creature in the area.

Lashing Rope.summary: You cause a section of rope or a rope-like object to animate, slither to your square, and encircle you, wreathing you in twisting, lashing fibers.

Lashunta's Life Bubble.summary: You create a replenishing protective bubble of fresh, temperate air around the target.

Lay on Hands.summary: Your hands become infused with powerful vitality, capable of healing a living creature or damaging an undead creature with a touch.

Leaden Steps.summary: Make creatures heavy and weak to electricity.

Leng Sting.summary: You use the power of nightmares to magically replicate the venomous attack of the aberrant and cunning Leng spiders.

Let not the Fallen Rest.summary: You exhort your fallen comrades to return to the battle.

Levitate.summary: Float an object or creature a few feet off the ground.

Liberating Command.summary: You call out a liberating cry, urging an ally to break free of an effect that holds them in place.

Life Boost.summary: Life force from your patron floods into the target, ensuring they can continue doing your patron's will for just a little longer.

Life Connection.summary: Set a contingency to take damage for an ally.

Life Link.summary: You forge a connection of life energy between you and your target, distributing harm between both of you.

Life Pact.summary: Using your life force or spirit as a conduit, you bind the targets in a mystical pact.

Life Siphon.summary: You use some of the spell's magic to heal yourself.

Life's Flowing River.summary: You create a flowing river of ghostly water and that sheds dim light for 10 feet on each side.

Life's Fresh Bloom.summary: The ground around you blooms with life, sprouting sparkling grass, flowers, and small shrubs.

Life-Draining Roots.summary: Roots hurt creatures in a line and transfer their vitality to you.

Life-Giving Form.summary: You transcend your physical form, becoming a beacon of healing energy.

Lifelink Surge.summary: You make a quick gesture, tracing the link between yourself and your eidolon and drawing on your connection to slowly strengthen your shared life force. Your eidolon gains fast healing 4 for 4 rounds.

Lifewood Cage.summary: Trap a creature in a wooden cage.

Lift Nature's Caul.summary: With a wave of the hand, you cause all creatures in the area to see the world around them as if a gauzy film had been lifted away to expose the truth that lies below their perceived reality.

Light of Revelation.summary: Shed light, granting a bonus to Perception.

Lightning Bolt.summary: Lightning strikes all creatures in a line.

Lightning Storm.summary: Create clouds and call down lightning.

Liminal Doorway.summary: A chalk door opens to an extradimensional hiding place.

Lingering Composition.summary: You add a flourish to your composition to extend its benefits.

Linnorm Sting.summary: You replicate the fiery venom of the tor linnorm and inflict an enemy with the dread dragon's debilitating bite.

Litany Against Wrath.summary: Your litany rails against the sin of wrath, punishing the target for attacking good creatures.

Litany against Sloth.summary: Your litany rails against the sin of sloth, interfering with the target's ability to react.

Litany of Depravity.summary: Your litany calls into question the morals your foe claims to hold dear.

Litany of Righteousness.summary: Your litany denounces an evildoer, rendering it susceptible to the powers of good.

Litany of Self-Interest.summary: You give a speech that fills your target with a drive to improve themself to the exclusion of assisting others.

Live Wire.summary: Slash and shock a creature with an electrified filament.

Localized Quake.summary: You shake the earth, toppling nearby creatures.

Locate.summary: Learn the direction to an object.

Lock.summary: Make a lock much harder to open.

Lock Item.summary: One object held by a creature becomes fused to that creature's hand and can't be put down.

Longstrider.summary: Increase your Speed for an hour.

Loose Time's Arrow.summary: You pluck the time stream like a bow - pull one string back, release, and watch a creature fly.

Loremaster's Etude.summary: You call upon your muse's deep mysteries, granting the target a greater ability to think and recall information.

Lose the Path.summary: React to impede and possibly divert a Stride.

Lotus Walk.summary: Bloom water plants that let you and others walk on water.

Love's Sacrifice.summary: You cry out for aid, and a creature near you feels compelled to throw itself in front of the threat as the ultimate expression of their love.

Lucky Break.summary: Reroll the saving throw and use the better result.

Lucky Number.summary: Set a contingency to reroll a specific, randomly chosen d20 result.

Luminous Stardust Healing.summary: You scatter twinkling sparks from your sentinel weapon, replenishing your allies' fighting spirit and driving out evil.

Lure Dream.summary: You reach out to the dream realm, beckoning an animate dream to your side.

Luring Wail.summary: You emit a plaintive cry to lure your enemies closer.

Mad Monkeys.summary: Summon magical monkey spirits to make mischief.

Mage Hand.summary: Command a floating hand to move an object.

Magic Aura.summary: Change how an item's magic appears to detecting spells.

Magic Fang.summary: Make a creature's unarmed attacks magical temporarily.

Magic Hide.summary: Your animal companion grows a thicker hide, matted fur, or a harder shell, granting it a +1 status bonus to AC.

Magic Missile.summary: Pelt creatures with unerring bolts of magical force.

Magic Mouth.summary: Make an illusory mouth appear to speak a message.

Magic Passage.summary: Open a temporary passage through a surface.

Magic Stone.summary: Make ordinary stones into magical sling bullets that are especially dangerous to undead.

Magic Warrior Aspect.summary: Gain the speed and senses of your totem animal.

Magic's Vessel.summary: A creature becomes a divine receptacle for pure magical energy.

Magical Fetters.summary: Ghostly manacles launch from your outstretched hand and clasp around the target's limbs, impeding its movements.

Magnetic Acceleration.summary: Magnetically launch an item to attack a foe.

Magnetic Attraction.summary: Pull items with magnetism, even disarming metal weapons.

Magnetic Dominion.summary: Reposition metal creatures and creatures in metal armor.

Magnetic Repulsion.summary: Push metal away, defending against metal weapons and armored foes.

Magnificent Mansion.summary: Conjure a secure dwelling in a demiplane.

Malediction.summary: You incite distress in the minds of your enemies, making it more difficult for them to defend themselves.

Malicious Shadow.summary: Your patron warps the target's shadow into a deadly form, such as strangling hands, a dangerous weapon, harrying runes, or the like.

Malignant Sustenance.summary: You embed a seed of void energy in an undead creature, restoring its unnatural vigor over time.

Manifest Will.summary: You unleash energy from the broken connection to your patron.

Manifestation.summary: Flexibly cast a 9th-rank spell from your tradition.

Manifestation Of Spirits.summary: You open the target's eyes to the plethora of spirits surrounding it - and it sees all these spirits as menacing and powerful.

Manifold Lives.summary: You cast a creature's mind back through time, forcing them to take other paths and make other choices, experiencing countless alternate lives in an instant.

Mantis's Grasp.summary: You cause red, ghostly mantis arms to sprout from a nearby surface.

Mantle of Heaven's Slopes.summary: You surround yourself in a mantle of heavenly power, invoking the power of the layers of the celestial mountain above.

Mantle of the Frozen Heart.summary: Morph your body with ice, which you can change during the spell.

Mantle of the Magma Heart.summary: Morph yourself with fire, which you can change during the spell.

Mantle of the Melting Heart.summary: Morph your body with metal, which you can change during the spell.

Mantle of the Unwavering Heart.summary: Morph your body with wood, which you can change during the spell.

Mariner's Curse.summary: Infect a creature with the curse of the rolling sea.

Mark of Blood.summary: You place a drop of your blood on a weapon and charge it with magic

Martyr's Intervention.summary: You shield a creature in dire need with your own life force, taking the harm upon yourself to save their life.

Mask of Terror.summary: A creature's fearsome illusory appearance frightens observers.

Maze.summary: Trap a creature in an extradimensional maze.

Maze of Locked Doors.summary: The target of your spell is drawn into a long, twisting, extradimensional hallway.

Medusa's Wrath.summary: You make an attack filled with a medusa's petrifying power.

Meld into Stone.summary: Meld into a block of stone.

Menacing Lament.summary: You wail a dirge for your enemies.

Mental Map.summary: You glean detailed information about a specific place visited by a creature directly from its mind.

Mercurial Stride.summary: Turn to quicksilver and move through creatures.

Message.summary: Speak a message to a distant creature, who can reply.

Message Rune.summary: You record a message up to 5 minutes long and inscribe a special rune on any flat unattended surface or small object within reach.

Meteor Swarm.summary: Call down four blazing meteors that explode.

Mimic Spell.summary: You learn the secrets of a spell just by watching someone else cast it.

Mind Blank.summary: Protect a creature from mental magic and some divinations.

Mind Games.summary: You lock minds with the target, trying to mentally subdue them.

Mind Probe.summary: Uncover knowledge and memories in a creature's mind.

Mind of Menace.summary: Set a contingency to punish a foe's mental effect and protect yourself from it.

Mindlink.summary: Mentally impart 10 minutes worth of information in an instant.

Miracle.summary: Ask for a blessing to duplicate divine spells.

Mirage.summary: Disguise one natural environment as another.

Mirecloak.summary: You wrap the targeted creatures in thin, sickly green shrouds that sap information from attackers.

Mirror Image.summary: Illusory duplicates of you cause attacks to miss.

Mirror Malefactors.summary: Mirrors surround a target, and the reflections attack them repeatedly.

Mirror's Misfortune.summary: Split into two copies. Destroying the fake curses the attacker.

Misdirection.summary: Cause one creature's auras to appear to be another's.

Mislead.summary: Turn invisible and create a duplicate of yourself who acts like you.

Missed Cue.summary: You make the spell's target believe they had something incredibly important to say but forgot to say it, and now they've missed their opportunity.

Mist.summary: Conceal creatures with a cloud of mist.

Misty Memory.summary: Replay a scene from the past through the medium of water.

Moment of Renewal.summary: Give a creature a day's worth of recovery in an instant.

Momentary Recovery.summary: You instantly teleport yourself and any items you're wearing or holding from your current space to a clear space within range that you can see.

Moon Frenzy.summary: Give willing creatures fangs and claws, and send them into a frenzy.

Moonbeam.summary: You shine a ray of moonlight.

Moonburst.summary: A powerful globe of chilling moonlight explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 cold damage to all creatures in the area, plus an additional 8d10 vitality damage to undead creatures.

Moonlight Bridge.summary: You summon a bridge of radiant, shimmering moonlight.

Moonlight Ray.summary: You unleash a holy beam of freezing moonlight.

Morass of Ages.summary: You surround yourself in temporal eddies that draw out time for those around you, making every step feel like an eternity endured.

Moth's Supper.summary: You sigh, and your breath transforms into delicate, black-winged butterflies and huge death's-head hawkmoths.

Mountain Resilience.summary: Harden a creature to resist physical attacks.

Movanic Glimmer.summary: You give the target animal a glimmer of awareness, not truly awakening it but allowing it to better understand its surroundings.

Murderous Vine.summary: Grab a creature with a vine.

Murmuration.summary: The target feels the brush of feathers against its skin and hears screeches in its ears, warning it to keep away from a creature you designate.

Mushroom Patch.summary: You cause mushrooms to sprout in the area.

Musical Shift.summary: With a quick series of wrist flicks, music fills the air.

Mutilate.summary: You cut your own body in a ritualistic manner, causing similar damage to a creature in your line of sight.

Mycological Malady.summary: You infect your target with fungal spores to hasten the cycle of decay.

Mystic Beacon.summary: The next damaging or healing spell the target casts before the start of your next turn deals damage or restores Hit Points as if the spell were heightened 1 rank higher than its actual rank.

Nature Incarnate.summary: Turn into a massive avatar of nature.

Nature's Bounty.summary: A palm-sized raw fruit or vegetable of your choice appears in your open hand.

Nature's Enmity.summary: Turn animals, plants, and weather against creatures of your choice.

Nature's Reprisal.summary: Anger plant life to slow and damage creatures.

Nature\u2019s Enmity.summary: Turn animals, plants, and weather against foes.

Necromancer's Generosity.summary: Heal your undead minion and protect it from vitality energy.

Necrotic Radiation.summary: You imbue the touched object or space with slow-acting necrotic radiation.

Necrotize.summary: Necrotize a foe's body, randomly debilitating them.

Needle Darts.summary: Turn a piece of metal into needles and shoot them at a foe.

Needle of Vengeance.summary: A long, jagged needle jabs into the target foe's psyche whenever it tries to attack a creature your patron holds in special regard.

Nettleskin.summary: Thorns sprout from your body; they pass through and don't damage any clothing or armor you wear.

Neutralize Poison.summary: Cure a poison afflicting a creature.

Nightmare.summary: Plague a creature's dreams with disturbing nightmares.

Noise Blast.summary: Damage and deafen creatures with a powerful din.

Nondetection.summary: Protect a creature or object from detection.

Nothing Up My Sleeve.summary: You create an extradimensional space within each of your sleeves.

Noxious Vapors.summary: Form a toxic cloud that poisons and sickens.

Nudge Fate.summary: The barest spin of your patron's spool is enough to alter fate.

Nullify.summary: React to automatically counteract a spell and take backlash damage.

Nymph's Grace.summary: Your apparition manifests as a mask of unearthly beauty that bewilders your enemies.

Nymph's Token.summary: You grant an ally a token of favor.

Oaken Resilience.summary: Confer a tree's resilience and flammability.

Oathkeeper's Insignia.summary: A magical indicator assures a creature that you've upheld your end of a bargain.

Object Memory.summary: By touching an object, you draw forth the experience of those who created and used it.

Object Reading.summary: Get psychic impressions from an object.

Obscuring Mist.summary: Conceal creatures in a cloud of mist.

Ocular Overload.summary: Set a contingency to interfere with the vision of a creature attacking you.

Omnidirectional Scan.summary: You quickly view your surroundings from a variety of angles, your senses constructing an overall mental picture.

One with Plants.summary: Meld into or turn into a plant.

One with Stone.summary: Meld into or turn into a stone.

One with the Land.summary: Merge into a natural feature to control the nearby environment.

Oneiric Mire.summary: Create illusory quicksand that tricks creatures into thinking they're stuck.

Ooze Form.summary: Turn into an ooze battle form.

Orb of Twisting Fate.summary: The glass orb of an omen dragon erupts from your target's forehead, overwhelming their mind with alternative options.

Ordained Purpose.summary: You call upon the authority of cosmic forces of order, overwhelming creatures with remorse and agony for acting outside of their station and purpose.

Organsight.summary: See a foe's organs, and use your knowledge to deal precision damage.

Osseous Cage.summary: You conjure a prison made of bone.

Outcast's Curse.summary: Curse a creature to be off-putting and abrasive.

Over the Coals.summary: You accuse the target of breaking its word to you and invoke the wrath of your patron to claim what's due, demanding the target pay you in currency, fulfill an order, or stand down.

Overflowing Sorrow.summary: Sadness flows out of you into nearby creatures, blotting out any other thoughts they had.

Overselling Flourish.summary: You make a grand spectacle out of getting hit.

Overstuff.summary: Huge amounts of food and drink fill the target.

Overwhelming Memory.summary: You cause the target to recall a specific type of memory.

Overwhelming Presence.summary: Assume the majesty of a god.

Pack Attack.summary: You and one other target gain an uncanny coordination that helps you take down foes.

Pack Breaker.summary: You can deceive creatures by changing their perception of their allies' behavior.

Pact Broker.summary: You offer to broker a pact of peace.

Pain Of Ages.summary: You sense a spiritual resonance of deep anguish in the earth beneath your feet, the walls surrounding you, or the fragments of souls left behind in a place of calamity.

Painful Vibrations.summary: Damage, sicken, and deafen a foe with sonic vibrations.

Painted Scout.summary: You press your hand to the stone, causing hand-drawn scouts to spread out from your fingers.

Passwall.summary: Form an earthen tunnel through a wall.

Path of Least Resistance.summary: You trace several possible routes, quickly resetting the timeline until you find the safest one.

Patron's Puppet.summary: At your unspoken plea, your patron temporarily assumes control over your familiar.

Pave Ground.summary: Even out the ground in a line.

Peaceful Bubble.summary: Opaque bubble prevents detection, dreams, perception, and scrying.

Peaceful Rest.summary: A corpse doesn't decay and can't become undead.

Penumbral Disguise.summary: You wrap the target in shadows, granting it a +1 status bonus to Stealth checks to Hide while in dim light or darkness.

Penumbral Shroud.summary: You envelop the target in a shroud of shadow.

Perceive the Threads of Fate.summary: You open your mind to the grand design of existence, enabling you to view the threads of fate in all their complex, tangled glory.

Percussive Impact.summary: You lob a compressed ball of sound at a foe.

Perfected Body.summary: Your body's perfection keeps you just a little bit healthier than most.

Perfected Form.summary: Reroll a failed saving throw against a morph, petrification, or polymorph effect.

Perfected Mind.summary: You meditate upon perfection to remove all distractions from your mind.

Pernicious Poltergeist.summary: Call forth a poltergeist to make mischief.

Perseis's Precautions.summary: Leaving nothing to chance, you weave divinatory precautions against an ambush, alerting the target to danger.

Persistent Servant.summary: Summon a long-term, unseen servant for a single task.

Personal Blizzard.summary: Your patron's breath becomes a blizzard of obscuring, scouring ice that follows your target.

Personal Ocean.summary: Surround yourself in a bubble of water.

Personal Rain Cloud.summary: You conjure a 5-foot-wide rain cloud that follows the target wherever it goes.

Personal Runewell.summary: The runelords of Thassilon pioneered the creation of runewells, magical artifacts that could extract and store the power of sin magic from mortal souls.

Pest Swarm.summary: Sometimes the most common irritations can band together and become threats to your enemies.

Pet Cache.summary: Hide a familiar or animal companion in a pocket dimension.

Petal Storm.summary: A storm of razor-sharp petals slashes creatures in the area.

Petrify.summary: Turn a creature into a stone statue.

Phantasmagoria.summary: You fill the targets' minds with endless images, like countless dreams and lives colliding with each other.

Phantasmal Calamity.summary: Create visions of an apocalypse to damage creatures mentally.

Phantasmal Killer.summary: Place a fearsome image in a creature's mind to scare and possibly kill it.

Phantom Prison.summary: Trap a creature in illusory walls.

Phase Bolt.summary: You point your finger and project a bolt of magical energy that stutters in and out of phase until it reaches the target.

Phoenix Ward.summary: Protect yourself from dying from fire.

Physical Boost.summary: You temporarily improve the target's physique.

Pied Piping.summary: Your performance enraptures listeners, compelling them to follow you.

Pillar of Water.summary: Create a column of water creatures can swim through.

Pinpoint.summary: Learn the exact location of a creature or object.

Planar Palace.summary: Conjure a secure dwelling in a demiplane.

Planar Seal.summary: Raise a barrier against teleportation and summoning.

Planar Tether.summary: Keep a creature on its current plane.

Plane Shift.summary: Transport creatures to another plane of existence.

Plant Form.summary: Turn into a dangerous plant creature.

Polar Ray.summary: Bitter cold damages and drains a creature.

Pollen Pods.summary: Cultivate trap-like pollen bulbs that explode.

Poltergeist's Fury.summary: Your fury spills over in a telekinetic storm of terrifying proportions.

Portrait of the Artist.summary: Appear to have the features and skills of a famous artist.

Positive Attunement.summary: Attune a creature to the Positive Energy Plane, healing a living creature or damaging an undead.

Positive Luminance.summary: Drawing life force into yourself, you become a beacon of positive energy.

Possession.summary: Send your mind and soul into another creature's body.

Power Word Kill.summary: Utter a word that slays a creature.

Power Word Stun.summary: Utter a word that stuns a creature.

Powerful Inhalation.summary: You rapidly draw the air from your surroundings, hoarding it for yourself.

Practice Makes Perfect.summary: The target gains a +2 status bonus to the triggering check, or a +3 bonus if the target has master or better proficiency in the skill.

Precious Metals.summary: Your deity blesses base metals to transform them into precious materials.

Prismatic Wall.summary: Form a protective wall with seven chromatic layers.

Private Sanctum.summary: Black fog prevents sensing, scrying, and mind-reading on anyone within.

Procyal Philosophy.summary: The racoon-like visage of a sagacious procyal appears, dispensing helpful advice.

Produce Flame.summary: Kindle small flames to attack close or at range.

Project Image.summary: Make an illusion of yourself you can cast spells through.

Proliferating Eyes.summary: You implant a contagious, scrying eye that spreads to others by touch.

Puff of Poison.summary: Exhale toxins to poison a foe.

Pulse of Civilization.summary: You tap into the zeitgeist of any settlements in range.

Purple Worm Sting.summary: Damage a creature and infect it with purple worm venom.

Pyrotechnics.summary: You turn a fire into either a burst of blinding fireworks or a thick cloud of choking smoke

Qi Blast.summary: You unleash your qi as a powerful blast that deals 2d6 force damage.

Quandary.summary: Trap a creature in an extradimensional puzzle.

Rallying Banner.summary: You create an illusory banner representing a revolution, social movement, or organization such as the Firebrands.

Ranage's Circle.summary: Many stories tell of a clearing deep in the Mwangi jungle, surrounded by ancient cypress trees

Ranger's Bramble.summary: You cause plants in the area to entangle your foes, with the effects of entangling flora .

Rapid Adaptation.summary: Adapt your companion or eidolon to your environment.

Rapid Retreat.summary: You know how to swiftly escape from harm.

Ravening Maw.summary: You evoke Zevgavizeb's unceasing hunger and inflict it upon your target.

Ray of Corruption.summary: You unleash a sickly gray beam of toxic spores at your target.

Reaper\u2019s Lantern.summary: A ghostly lantern diminishes healing for the living and weakens the undead.

Rebuke Death.summary: You snatch creatures from the jaws of death, restoring them without the strain of a typical close call.

Rejuvenating Flames.summary: You create a gout of flame that both heals and burns.

Remember the Lost.summary: You call upon the lost and forgotten, assailing your foes' minds with the memories of those who died with a grievance toward them.

Resilient Sphere.summary: Create a sphere of force that blocks anything that would come through.

Revealing Light.summary: Dazzling light counters invisibility and concealment.

Revel in Retribution.summary: Time seems to slow for you, allowing you to strike your opponents mid-move.

Revival.summary: Heal creatures in an area and return the dead to life temporarily.

Rewrite Possibility.summary: You continually glimpse into the target's future and nudge fate to guide them toward the best possible outcome.

Rime Slick.summary: You call down a chill wind.

Roar of the Wyrm.summary: You channel the might of dragons into your voice, letting out a roar that engenders respect in dragonkind but that instills fear in most other creatures.

Roaring Applause.summary: Force the target to cheer and applaud you.

Root Reading.summary: Learn about an area using root systems.

Rope Trick.summary: Animate a rope that rises to an extradimensional hiding place.

Rose's Thorns.summary: Rose bushes with razor-sharp thorns sprout from the ground in the area.

Rouse Skeletons.summary: Rouse a squadron of skeletons to claw foes.

Rousing Splash.summary: Splash a creature to invigorate it and wash away acid and fire.

Rubble Step.summary: Have an ally leave rubble as it moves.

Rune of Observation.summary: You inscribe an invisible eye-shaped rune in the air, creating a sensor as clairvoyance .

Rust Cloud.summary: Make a cloud of rusty flecks that cuts creatures and rusts metal.

Sanctuary.summary: Protect a creature from being attacked.

Sand Form.summary: Turn a creature's body and gear into sand.

Sanguine Mist.summary: Create a cloud of life-draining fog.

Scouting Eye.summary: Invisible eye transmits what it sees to you.

Scrounger's Glee.summary: With a cruel laugh and a flash of your canines, you make a target understand that death is coming to claim it and that its demise will serve to strengthen another.

Scrying.summary: Spy on a creature you choose.

Scrying Ripples.summary: Scry from one body of water into another.

Serrate.summary: With a pinch, the metal of a weapon twists, adding numerous jagged blades along its surface.

Shadow Army.summary: yourself to have your shadows fight enemies as you hide among them.

Shadow Blast.summary: Shape a damaging cone of shadow substance to deal damage of a type you choose.

Shambling Horror.summary: You reanimate the corpse of a fallen creature as an undead minion under your control.

Shape Wood.summary: Transform unworked wood into a shape of your choice.

Shapechange.summary: Transform into a form of your choice repeatedly.

Share Burden.summary: You shoulder some of your ally's pain.

Share Life.summary: Absorb half the damage another would take.

Share Lore.summary: You share your knowledge with the touched creatures.

Shared Invisibility.summary: You and nearby creatures become invisible.

Shared Nightmare.summary: Merging minds with the target, you swap distressing visions.

Shatter.summary: Shatter an object with a high-frequency sonic attack.

Shatter Mind.summary: You telepathically assail the minds of your foes.

Shattering Gem.summary: A large gem floats around the target in an erratic pattern.

Sheltering Wings.summary: Like migratory birds, you know everyone flies farther together.

Shepherd of Souls.summary: You stay the hand of fate for one not yet destined to die, sacrificing some of your own vitality to heal them.

Shield Other.summary: Absorb half the damage an ally would take.

Shielded Arm.summary: Reinforce a creature's arm with metal that lets it use its arm as a shield.

Show the Way.summary: You and allies in the area gain preternatural knowledge of the path ahead, allowing you to intuit the best way forward and avoid potential obstacles, such as difficult or confusing terrain.

Shrink.summary: Reduce a willing creature to Tiny size.

Shrink Item.summary: Reduce an object to the size of a coin.

Shrink the Span.summary: The world seems to shrink before your footfalls.

Shroud of Flame.summary: You encircle yourself in an aura of protective flames.

Shroud of Night.summary: Your patron blankets the target's eyes in darkness.

Soothing Blossoms.summary: Flowers assist recovery from persistent damage and afflictions.
