Spellwrack.summary: Curse a creature to be harmed when a spell is cast on it and lower the duration of its spells.

Spider Climb.summary: Give a creature a climb Speed.

Spider Sting.summary: Damage a creature and afflict it with spider venom.

Spike Stones.summary: Grow sharp spikes out of the ground.

Spinning Staff.summary: You spin your staff with an impossibly quick twirling flourish, attacking two foes and transforming the momentum into magical energy to charge for your next Spellstrike.

Spiral of Horrors.summary: Shades and spirits howl and whirl around you in a display that strikes fear into the hearts of all who witness it.

Spirit Link.summary: Continually transfer your health to someone else.

Spirit Object.summary: Using a sliver of Baba Yaga's power, you briefly bring a nearby object to life.

Spirit Song.summary: Sing a song that damages any creature with a spirit.

Spirit Veil.summary: You draw an occluding veil of spirits around yourself, blocking yourself especially well from undead eyes.

Spirit Ward.summary: You draw on nearby spiritual energy or on echoes of the spirits you've invoked throughout your life to temporarily ward living flesh against dangerous spirits.

Spirit of the Beast.summary: You bring out the spirit of another animal that lives within your companion.

Spiritual Anamnesis.summary: Overwhelm a target with memories of a past life.

Spiritual Armament.summary: Project a weapon imbued with spiritual power.

Spiritual Attunement.summary: Attune to an aligned plane to protect yourself and harm creatures opposed to that plane.

Spiritual Epidemic.summary: Weaken a target with a communicable curse.

Spiritual Guardian.summary: Create a magical guardian to attack at your command and take damage for your allies.

Spiritual Renewal.summary: You draw upon the restorative power of the spirits around you.

Spiritual Torrent.summary: You release your spiritual essence in a torrential blast of energy, dealing 10d6 damage.

Spiritual Transport.summary: You call upon the spiritual energies surrounding you to teleport you to an unoccupied space within range that you can see.

Spiritual Weapon.summary: Materialize a deific weapon of force that appears and attacks repeatedly.

Splash of Art.summary: A deluge of colorful illusory paint, tools, or other symbols of art and artisanship drift down in the area.

Splinter Volley.summary: Fling sharp splinters at one or more enemies.

Split the Tongue.summary: The deceiving creature's tongue splits like a serpent's tongue.

Spout.summary: Batter creatures with a water blast.

Spray of Stars.summary: You fling a spray of tiny shooting stars, dealing 2d4 fire damage.

Spy's Mark.summary: By pressing your hand to a wall or other solid immobile surface, you cause the crossed-swords symbol of the Firebrands - or a different symbol of your choosing - to appear on the targeted surface.

Stagnate Time.summary: You examine the time stream in a particular area, then proceed to stick a few metaphorical pins into it, thickening and slowing down the flow of time until it rumbles along like a river of molasses.

Stasis.summary: The flow of time congeals around an object or creature, holding it in place.

Status.summary: Keep track of a willing creature's location and wellbeing.

Steal Shadow.summary: You steal a creature's shadow, leaving it weakened and vulnerable.

Steal Voice.summary: You steal a creature's voice, rendering them mute.

Steal the Sky.summary: You deny a flying creature the support of the air.

Steel Fortifications.summary: You conjure several metal structures that consist of angled beams attached to one another at a central point, which can help block attacks.

Sticky Fire.summary: You send a bubble of viscous liquid that sparks into flame.

Stifling Stillness.summary: Make air hard to breathe and traverse.

Sting of the Sea.summary: A long tentacle like that belonging to an octopus, anemone, or man-of-war, dripping with briny water, appears from a glowing blue portal to wrap around the target's face, blocking its vision.

Stinking Cloud.summary: Form a cloud that sickens creatures.

Stoke the Heart.summary: Your patron fills a creature with fervor, empowering their blows.

Stone Lance.summary: You conjure a jagged lance of stone and then launch it at a foe.

Stone Tell.summary: Speak to spirits within natural stone.

Stone to Flesh.summary: Turn a creature turned to stone back to flesh.

Stoneskin.summary: Harden a creature's skin into durable stone.

Store Time.summary: You store time for later use.

Storm Lord.summary: The sky above you darkens in a matter of moments, swirling with ominous clouds punctuated by flashes of lighting.

Stormburst.summary: Your voice projects like cracking thunder as you summon a localized storm, creating a fearsome surge of lightning and wind.

Stormwind Flight.summary: Powerful winds carry you through the air, giving you a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

Strange Geometry.summary: Confoundingly warp spatial geometry, making passage difficult and destinations unpredictable.

Strength of Mind.summary: You bolster your ally with reminders of their physical prowess, granting them additional defenses against harmful mental effects.

String of Fate.summary: You bond yourself to a cherished friend, vowing to share their fate for good or for ill.

Stumbling Curse.summary: With a twist of a finger, you send a creature careening on a haphazard trajectory.

Stupefy.summary: Dull a target's mind and make spell casting unreliable.

Subconscious Suggestion.summary: Plant a suggestion in a creature's mind that is must follow when a trigger occurs.

Subjugate Undead.summary: You attempt to seize control of the target undead.

Sudden Bolt.summary: You call down a small bolt of lightning on the target

Sudden Recollection.summary: Plant information in a creature's subconscious to be revealed on a trigger you choose.

Sudden Shift.summary: You swiftly move from a dangerous spot and veil yourself.

Sudden Transposition.summary: You wrench the targets off their feet, forcefully teleporting them within the area.

Suffocate.summary: You forcefully and cruelly draw the living breath from a creature's lungs, dealing 4d8 bludgeoning damage.

Suggestion.summary: Suggest a course of action a creature must follow.

Summon Anarch.summary: Summon a chaotic celestial, monitor, or fiend.

Summon Ancient Fleshforged.summary: You summon an ancient Fleshforged, one of Nex's personal weaponized monstrosities unleashed in the first wars against Geb.

Summon Animal.summary: Conjure an animal to fight for you.

Summon Archmage.summary: Summon an incarnate archmage to fire magic missiles, stupefy foes, and tear away their spells.

Summon Axiom.summary: Summon a lawful celestial, monitor, or fiend.

Summon Celestial.summary: Conjure a celestial to fight for you.

Summon Construct.summary: Conjure a construct to fight on your behalf.

Summon Deific Herald.summary: Summon an incarnate representative of your deity, with effects depending on alignment.

Summon Draconic Legion.summary: Summon an incarnate legion of dragons to destroy your foes.

Summon Dragon.summary: Conjure a dragon to fight on your behalf.

Summon Elemental.summary: Conjure an elemental to fight on your behalf.

Summon Elemental Herald.summary: Summon an incarnate elemental to create a natural disaster.

Summon Entity.summary: Conjure an aberration to fight on your behalf.

Summon Fey.summary: Conjure a fey to fight on your behalf.

Summon Fiend.summary: Conjure a fiend to fight on your behalf.

Summon Giant.summary: Conjure a giant to fight on your behalf.

Summon Healing Servitor.summary: You call forth a servitor forged from raw positive energy to heal and bolster your allies.

Summon Instrument.summary: Call an instrument that only you can play.

Summon Irii.summary: You cast your spell, whisper your words of power, and find that an irii is already here.

Summon Kaiju.summary: Summon an incarnate kaiju with effects depending on the specific kaiju.

Summon Lesser Servitor.summary: Summon a minor celestial, monitor, or fiend.

Summon Monitor.summary: Conjure a planar monitor to fight on your behalf.

Summon Oliphaunt Of Jandelay.summary: You briefly summon the mythical Oliphaunt of Jandelay, unleashing a manifestation of pure destruction that obliterates everything unfortunate enough to stand in its path.

Summon Plant or Fungus.summary: Conjure a plant or fungus to fight on your behalf.

Summon Stampede.summary: You summon an unstoppable stampede of panicking beasts.

Summon Undead.summary: Conjure an undead to fight on your behalf.

Summon Warden of the Wild.summary: You briefly call forth the spirit of one of the Wardens of the Wild, the legendary guardians of nature.

Summoner's Precaution.summary: Set a contingency to avoid being knocked out alongside your eidolon.

Summoner's Visage.summary: Change your eidolon to cosmetically appear to be your identical twin.

Sun Blade.summary: Launch a bolt of divine sunfire.

Sun's Fury.summary: The target weapon becomes wreathed in a glowing flame.

Sunburst.summary: A globe of sunlight deals fire damage, hurts undead, and overcomes darkness.

Sure Footing.summary: Counteract clumsy, grabbed, paralyzed, or related conditions.

Sure Strike.summary: Your next attack is especially accurate.

Suspended Retribution.summary: All life dances one step from the precipice, one heartbeat from disaster.

Swallow Light.summary: You draw magical light into your open mouth, consuming it and turning its essence into fuel for a gout of life-draining shadows.

Swamp of Sloth.summary: Ground in the area turns swampy and fetid.

Swampcall.summary: You call upon the spirits of the soil to twist and churn, transforming the terrain in the targeted area into a sodden mess.

Swarm Form.summary: You discorporate into a swarm of Tiny creatures.

Swarming Wasp Stings.summary: You manifest a swarm of disembodied wasp stingers that stab creatures in the area, possibly poisoning them.

Swarmsense.summary: You extend your senses through a multitude of crawling and flying creatures.

Swear Oath.summary: You loudly and firmly state a course of action that you swear to fulfill.

Sweet Dream.summary: With soothing words, you lull the target into an enchanting dream.

Symphony of the Unfettered Heart.summary: Your symphony lifts listeners from their worldly concerns.

Synaptic Pulse.summary: Slow creatures with a mental blast.

Synchronize.summary: Place sigils on your targets that flash at a prespecified time.

Synchronize Steps.summary: You link the minds of two targets, enabling them to move in tandem.

Tailwind.summary: Increase your speed for an hour.

Take Root.summary: Reinforce a creature's stance or grip with roots.

Take Your Places.summary: The scene would play out exactly as you envisioned it, if only the actors would respect their blocking.

Take its Course.summary: When someone has overindulged, you can hasten them past the worst of their affliction or intensify their misery.

Talking Corpse.summary: Have a corpse answer three questions.

Tame.summary: Make a domesticated animal friendlier to you.

Tangle Vine.summary: Conjure a vine to entangle a creature.

Tanglecurse.summary: Tanglebriar has been called a "curse on the land," which has inspired Treerazer's cult to develop this notorious spell.

Tanglefoot.summary: Conjure a vine to entangle a creature.

Tangling Creepers.summary: Entangle creatures in a burst and concentrate to lash out with immobilizing vines.

Teeth to Terror.summary: The target believes its teeth are falling out, crawling along its face, stabbing into its body, and cramming themselves down its throat.

Telekinetic Bombardment.summary: You grasp a piece of the landscape - such as a tree, carriage, or piece of masonry - and lob it in your foe's direction.

Telekinetic Hand.summary: Move an object with a floating hand.

Telekinetic Maneuver.summary: Disarm, Reposition, Shove, or Trip a creature telekinetically.

Telekinetic Projectile.summary: Fling an object at a creature.

Telekinetic Rend.summary: Your mind creates a violent axis of motion in a nearby space that can smash or sever at your will.

Telepathic Bond.summary: Link minds with willing creatures to communicate telepathically at great distances.

Telepathic Demand.summary: Impel a creature with a mental message.

Telepathy.summary: Communicate telepathically with any creatures near you.

Teleport.summary: Transport you and willing creatures a great distance.

Tempest Cloak.summary: Protect a creature with swirling winds.

Tempest Surge.summary: You surround a foe in a swirling storm of violent winds, roiling clouds, and crackling lightning.

Tempest Touch.summary: Your touch calls forth a churning mass of icy water that clings to your target, dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage and 1d4 cold damage.

Tempest of Shades.summary: Summon an incarnate tornado of undead shades to drain and frighten foes.

Temporal Distortion.summary: You share some of your own temporal distortions with a foe, altering their mind and body unpredictably as they're thrown backward or forward in time.

Temporal Twin.summary: You pull a fleeting duplicate of your ally from the recent past

Temporal Ward.summary: You ward a target doorway or container with a temporal trap that rewinds the personal timeline of creatures trying to open it.

Temporary Glyph.summary: Quickly scribe a short-lived glyph to blast foes.

Temporary Tool.summary: You conjure a temporary simple tool, such as a shovel or rope into your hands.

Tempt Fate.summary: You twist the forces of fate to make a moment dire or uneventful, with no in-between.

Tentacular Limbs.summary: Your arms turn into long, pliable tentacles, increasing your reach when you're delivering touch range spells and making unarmed Strikes with your arms (such as fist and claw Strikes) to 10 feet.

Terrain Transposition.summary: You mystically transpose your current location with another.

Tesseract Tunnel.summary: You race from point to point, tearing open a tunnel in space.

Tether.summary: You use magical chains, vines, or other tethers to bind your target to you.

The Four Hunters.summary: This is a story of four evenly matched hunters who sought to capture a falling star.

The Parrot's Whisper.summary: You call forth an echo of the gossiping parrot from the tale of the Witch and the Weave.

The Queen's Rainbow.summary: You tell the story of the Queen of Bees and her retinue trying to pass through a rainbow on their way to visit the King of Spiders.

Thermal Remedy.summary: Adjust ingredients in food and drink for health benefits.

Thermal Stasis.summary: The same abilities that let you raise or lower thermal energy also let you keep it at a safe medium.

Thicket of Knives.summary: Illusory copies of your weapon arm improve your ability to feint.

Thief of Fortune.summary: Seeing another creature improve themself with magic, you reach out and seize its benefits for yourself.

Thoughtful Gift.summary: Teleport an item to an ally's grasp.

Threatening Mimicry.summary: You appear larger and stronger to nearby creatures, appearing to possess threatening features like antlers, claws, or poison to their senses.

Threefold Limb.summary: You temporarily transform one of your limbs into water, taking the form of ice, liquid water, or steam as you desire.

Thunderburst.summary: You create a powerful blast of air and a loud peal of thunder, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage and 2d6 sonic damage.

Thundering Dominance.summary: Make your companion or eidolon intimidating, and let it emit a sonic roar.

Thunderous Strike.summary: You swing your massive weapon, creating a wave of sonic vibrations that topples creatures.

Tidal Surge.summary: You call forth a tremendous wave to move the target either in a body of water or on the ground.

Time Beacon.summary: You create a beacon in time to return to it if things go wrong

Time Jump.summary: Leap forward in time, moving swiftly.

Time Pocket.summary: You fling the target item forward in time and link it to the future of the creature holding it.

Time Sense.summary: When you Cast the Spell, you gain a perfect sense of time.

Time Skip.summary: You manipulate time around your ally, pushing them forward a few moments in time.

Time Stop.summary: Briefly stop time for everything but you.

Timely Tutor.summary: Connect your eidolon or familiar to the Akashic Record to briefly grant it knowledge.

Tireless Worker.summary: You suppress your choice of one of the following conditions that's affecting the target: clumsy, encumbered, enfeebled, or fatigued.

Tomorrow's Dawn.summary: The golden light of a new dawn and the promise of life beyond death radiates from your body.

Tongues.summary: Let a creature understand and speak all languages.

Tortoise and the Hare.summary: Quicken an ally and slow a foe.

Torturous Trauma.summary: You batter a creature's internal organs, leaving no external signs of the immense pain you delivered.

Touch of Corruption.summary: The antipaladin infuses the target with negative energy.

Touch of Idiocy.summary: Dull a target's mind with a touch.

Touch of Obedience.summary: Your imperious touch erodes the target's willpower, making it easier to control.

Touch of Undeath.summary: You attack the target's life force with undeath, dealing 1d6 void damage.

Touch of the Moon.summary: When you touch the target, a symbol of the moon appears on its forehead, glowing with soft moonlight.

Touch of the Void.summary: You infuse the target with void energy, healing undead or damaging a living creature.

Toxic Cloud.summary: A bank of poison fog rolls away from you.

Trade Death for Life.summary: Your patron steals life from one of your enemies to grant it to another.

Trade Items.summary: You magically swap an item you're holding for another that someone else has.

Transcribe Conflict.summary: You cause a sheet of paper to appear in your hand, and a moment later a detailed description of a combat you experienced within the last hour is recorded on that sheet of paper in a language that you know of your choice.

Transcribe Moment.summary: You instantly create a small, permanent scroll that contains a magically precise written description of your current surroundings in every direction.

Translate.summary: Grant understanding of a language to one creature.

Transmute Rock and Mud.summary: Turn an area of rock into mud or vice versa.

Travel by Turtle.summary: You conjure an intelligent sea turtle, who agrees to carry you upon its shell on a water journey.

Traveler's Transit.summary: You add power to your muscles, allowing you to swim or climb walls with ease.

Traveling Workshop.summary: Your apparition guides you through complex procedures while using your magic to provide you with whatever tools you need.

Tree of Seasons.summary: Grow a tree with four explosive seedpods.

Trickster's Feathers.summary: You conjure four magic feathers, each with the potential to hold a single illusory guise.

Trickster's Mirrors.summary: You are surrounded by up to 3 mirrors that reflect twisted and distorted images of you, making it hard to tell where you actually are within your space and potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the mirrors instead.

Trickster's Twin.summary: You rarely settle for being in just one place.

Trim the Blight.summary: You create a cone of shimmering energy that attempts to banish the influence of invasive, supernatural blight, such as that found in Tanglebriar.

Triple Time.summary: Your music sets a fast pace.

True Strike.summary: Make your next attack especially accurate.

True Target.summary: Make multiple attacks against a creature especially accurate.

Truesight.summary: See through illusions and physical transformations.

Truespeech.summary: Let a creature understand and speak all languages.

Turbulent Tide.summary: You cause the sheath of water and the improvised weapon it surrounds to surge outward with stupendous force as you attack.

Ulcerous Canker.summary: Weeping sores open on the target as you expose it to decay, dealing 1d4 void damage and 1d4 poison damage plus 1 persistent bleed damage.

Umbral Extraction.summary: Attempt to steal a spell slot.

Umbral Graft.summary: Attempt to steal an active spell.

Umbral Mindtheft.summary: You prepare to steal a broad field of knowledge from another creature, siphoning it from their mind and storing it in a pocket of the Shadow Plane connected to your own mind.

Unblinking Flame Aura.summary: You focus your sight inside and call on your inner fire to grant you warmth, steady your vision, and soothe your body.

Unblinking Flame Emblem.summary: You emblazon the target with a fiery sigil that projects your sight and your flame onto them, allowing you and your allies to track their movements and making it easier to hit them.

Unblinking Flame Ignition.summary: You feel the most alive when pushed into a corner, as the insights and vision granted by the flame stoke into overdrive.

Unbreaking Wave Advance.summary: Unleash a blast of water to push back foes.

Unbreaking Wave Barrier.summary: You create a protective circle around yourself that repels your foes.

Unbreaking Wave Containment.summary: You wrap enemies in four strands of water.

Unbreaking Wave Vapor.summary: You're concealed against the triggering attack and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against it.

Unbroken Panoply.summary: As tools of violence undone by violence, broken weapons contain potent symbolic magic that faydhaans often call upon when forming alliances.

Uncontrollable Dance.summary: Overcome a target with an allconsuming urge to dance.

Undeath's Blessing.summary: You instill within a creature the touch of the grave.

Undermine Reality.summary: You lash a target with tendrils of shadow that steal some of its substance, making it quasi-real.

Undertaker.summary: You point your finger toward the target and whisper an epitaph that promises to grace their gravestone in the near future.

Undetectable Alignment.summary: Make a creature or object appear neutral to alignment detection.

Unexpected Transposition.summary: React to switch places with a creature.

Unexpected Windfall.summary: Coins, trinkets carved from heavy stone, and other cumbersome treasures rain down upon a foe.

Unfathomable Song.summary: Song debilitates creatures in weird and powerful ways.

Unfetter Eidolon.summary: You loosen the link between yourself and your eidolon, allowing them to travel farther from you for a short period of time and aiding them against being immobilized.

Unfettered Movement.summary: Repel effects that would hold a creature in place.

Unfolding Wind Blitz.summary: You blitz forward so quickly that you soar through the air, and nothing can react to you.

Unfolding Wind Buffet.summary: You surround your unarmed attacks with the speed and force of air.

Unfolding Wind Crash.summary: You jump up to 120 feet in any direction and then deal 18d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures within a 20-foot emanation after you land, with a basic Reflex save.

Unholy Army.summary: Reaching out to the legions of the wicked, you call upon them for assistance.

Unimpeded Stride.summary: Divine grace ensure that nothing can keep you prisoner or hold you back.

Unity.summary: You put up a united defense.

Unravel Knowledge.summary: Your patron reaches into the target's mind, plucking out their past training like pulling a thread from a cloth.

Unraveling Blast.summary: You unleash a small blast of potential that destroys one of a creature's possible futures, leaving them reeling.

Unrelenting Observation.summary: You and other creatures track a subject exactly using scrying.

Unseasonable Squall.summary: You issue a blast of sudden wind that ripples outward from the center of the burst.

Unseen Servant.summary: Create an invisible creature to help you.

Unsettling Knowledge.summary: You share a piece of hidden knowledge with a creature that is both upsetting and intriguing.

Unspeakable Shadow.summary: Transform a creature's shadow into a frightening monster and make them flee or fight it.

Untamed Form.summary: You reach within for a different part of yourself, and you set it free, transforming your body into another form.

Untamed Shift.summary: You transform just a part of your body.

Untwisting Iron Augmentation.summary: Your unarmed attacks are treated as cold iron and silver, they gain the earth trait, and they gain a +1 status bonus to damage rolls per damage die.

Untwisting Iron Pillar.summary: You call upon the earth and your ki to shield you from your enemies.

Untwisting Iron Roots.summary: You manipulate the earth beneath your feet to throw your enemies off balance, leaving chunks of rock and rubble behind.

Unusual Anatomy.summary: You transform your flesh and organs into a bizarre amalgam of glistening skin, rough scales, tufts of hair, and tumorous protuberances.

Updraft.summary: A powerful blast of wind erupts from the ground, launching the target into the air and sending it crashing back down.

Upheaval.summary: The ground in the area shudders and crumbles as huge pillars of stone erupt into the air, rending the terrain around them.

Uplifting Overture.summary: Your performance makes allies feel they can succeed at anything.

Utter Destruction.summary: You screech with an unearthly voice made of destructive energy, smashing everything that lies before you.

Vacuum.summary: Inhale to steal breath from creatures around you.

Valiant Anthem.summary: You chant a rallying cry to bolster your allies.

Vampiric Exsanguination.summary: Draw blood and life force from creatures in a cone, harming them and healing yourself.

Vampiric Feast.summary: Deal void damage and gain temporary Hit Points with a touch.

Vampiric Maiden.summary: An iron maiden steals a creature's vitality.

Vampiric Touch.summary: Deal negative damage and gain temporary HP with a touch.

Variable Gravity.summary: Adjust gravity's grip between high, low, and normal gravity.

Vector Screen.summary: You set up a transparent, rippling screen of telekinetic energy that seizes small, fast-moving projectiles

Veil.summary: Disguise many creatures as other creatures.

Veil Of Spirits.summary: You draw on the essence of spiritual energy surrounding you to manifest a misty veil.

Veil of Dreams.summary: Your patron draws the target into a drowsy state, causing daydreams and sluggishness.

Veil of Privacy.summary: Protect a creature or object from magical detection.

Vengeful Glare.summary: Your gaze falls on a creature, filled with icy vengeance or fiery wrath

Verdant Sprout.summary: Make a plant seed grow rapidly.

Verminous Lure.summary: Upon casting, the target emits a musk that's captivating to certain animals.

Vibrant Pattern.summary: Make a pattern of lights that dazzles and blinds creatures who enter the area.

Vibrant Thorns.summary: Your body sprouts brambly thorns that thrive on life magic.

Vibrant Vibrato.summary: Your voice trills in perfect vibrato.

Vicious Howl.summary: You howl with passion for your cause, empowering yourself to push beyond your limits.

Vicious Jealousy.summary: The target is overcome by deep jealousy and resentment that twists its mind against other creatures.

Victory Cry.summary: Your true might comes from your bonds with your allies, and you glory in their achievements.

Vigilant Eye.summary: You create an invisible eye sensor, as clairvoyance.

Vindicator's Judgement.summary: You pronounce a terrible judgment upon your quarry that causes all of your attacks and divine spells to strike with deadly efficacy.

Vindicator's Mark.summary: You launch a magical dart at your hunted prey, which marks them with a nimbus only you can detect.

Vision of Beauty.summary: You create a phantasmal image of the most beautiful creature imaginable to the target at a location somewhere within the spell's range.

Vision of Death.summary: Show the target a vision of their own death, causing fear and mental damage.

Vision of Weakness.summary: You focus your gaze on a creature and gain a flash of divine insight into its nature.

Visions of Danger.summary: A vision of a swarm deals mental damage.

Vital Beacon.summary: Radiate vitality that heals creatures that touch you.

Vital Luminance.summary: Drawing life force into yourself, you become a beacon of vitality.

Vitality Lash.summary: Damage and weaken the undead with vital energy.

Vitrifying Blast.summary: Glass shards cut creatures and turn them glass-like.

Void Warp.summary: Damage and weaken the living with void energy.

Volcanic Eruption.summary: Cause massive lava sprays that burn creatures and encase them in rock.

Vomit Swarm.summary: Vermin erupt in a cone from your mouth.

Voracious Gestalt.summary: Create a spirit gestalt that eats souls and grows stronger.

Wail of the Banshee.summary: Scream, dealing damage and draining creatures.

Wails of the Damned.summary: Scream, draining the living and causing void damage.

Waking Dream.summary: You cloud the target's mind with vivid, dreamlike imagery, so they have difficulty distinguishing real threats from imagined ones.

Waking Nightmare.summary: You fill the creature's mind with a terrifying vision.

Wall of Fire.summary: Create a blazing wall that burns creatures that pass through.

Wall of Flesh.summary: Spawn a wall of living flesh.

Wall of Force.summary: Create an invisible and durable plane of magical force.

Wall of Ice.summary: Sculpt a foot-thick wall of ice that blocks sight and can chill creatures.

Wall of Metal.summary: Shape a wall made of a particular metal.

Wall of Mirrors.summary: You create a solid wall of shimmering reflective glass up to 50 feet long and 20 feet high.

Wall of Radiance.summary: You create a thin wall of brilliant light in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high.

Wall of Shadow.summary: You form a wall of pure darkness in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high.

Wall of Shrubs.summary: Create a wall of shrubs that provide cover.

Wall of Virtue.summary: You create a translucent wall of light, which draws power from the celestial realms.

Wall of Water.summary: Create a wall of water, forcing foes to swim through.

Wall of Wind.summary: Create a wall of gusting winds that hinders movement and ranged attacks.

Wanderer's Guide.summary: Find an ideal route to a location.

Wanderer\u2019s Guide.summary: Find an ideal route to a location.

Warding Aggression.summary: Strike an enemy to improve your defense against it, and extend the spell with further attacks.

Warning Stripes.summary: Your skin becomes painted with vivid stripes or bright aposematic swirls, warning other creatures of its toxic qualities.

Warp Step.summary: When you walk, the earth warps beneath your feet - your steps extend, distance contracts, and everything is just a little bit closer.

Warped Terrain.summary: You create illusory hazards that cover all surfaces in the area.

Warping Pull.summary: You get an ally out of danger with a teleporting pull.

Warrior's Regret.summary: Regrets overcome a foe if they harm others.

Water Walk.summary: Buoy a creature so it can walk on water.

Waterproof.summary: Protect an object against becoming wet.

Wave of Despair.summary: Drive creatures in an area to despair.

Weaken Earth.summary: Reduce the durability of something made of earth.

Weapon Storm.summary: Multiply a weapon you hold and attack many creatures with it.

Weapon Surge.summary: Holding your weapon aloft, you fill it with divine energy.

Weapon Trance.summary: The serenity of violence fills your mind, giving you a heightened sense of knowing exactly where your weapons need to be.

Weapon of Judgment.summary: Form a divine weapon of war or peace.

Weaponize Secret.summary: You understand that holding a secret is in itself a kind of power.

Weave Wood.summary: Break plant fiber into strands and magically weave them.

Web.summary: Form a web that keeps creatures from moving.

Web of Eyes.summary: Put scrying sensors on creatures, allowing them to share their vision with others.

Web of Influence.summary: You learn the location of the nearest creature to whom the target is connected in a magical manner.

Weird.summary: Frighten, deal mental damage, and possibly kill large numbers of creatures.

Whirling Flames.summary: You call forth a storm of whirling flames, engulfing all creatures in that area and dealing 5d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save.

Whirling Scarves.summary: You surround yourself in a vortex of whirling colorful scarves of force that obfuscate you and disorient your foes.

Whirlwind.summary: Create a moving tornado to damage creatures and raise them into the air.

Whispering Quiet.summary: You suppress sound in an area, preventing anyone from giving away valuable secrets.

Whispers of the Void.summary: Drain creatures' vigor with void energy.

Wholeness of Body.summary: You focus your ki to heal yourself.

Wild Morph.summary: You morph your body based on your training, choosing one of the following effects based on your wild order feats.

Wild Shape.summary: You infuse yourself with primal essence and transform yourself into another form.

Wild Winds Stance.summary: You take on the stance of the flowing winds, sending out waves of energy at a distance.

Wildfire.summary: A thin layer of ash and flame covers the ground in the area.

Wilding Word.summary: Your patron's majesty - or their displeasure - comes in a growl from your throat, making other creatures reluctant to harm you.

Wind Jump.summary: You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

Wind Whispers.summary: You call forth numerous breezes in which you weave gossip, whispering subtly into the ears of those around.

Wings of the Valkyrie.summary: Powerful feathered wings - usually vibrant white or jet black - emerge from your back, granting you a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

Winning Streak.summary: Quicken a target and make its critical hits spread the quickness.

Winter Bolt.summary: You fling a hollow icicle filled with winter's wrath.

Wish.summary: Make a wish to duplicate arcane spells.

Wish-Twisted Form.summary: You focus your magic upon an enemy, wishing for their defenses to fail and turning their strengths into weaknesses.

Withering Grasp.summary: Your touch rots organic material and decays objects.

Wood Walk.summary: Wood shapes itself according to your will readily, making staircases appear as you climb up the side of a tree, automatically weaving vines into ladders, or lowering branches to lift you up to the top.

Wooden Double.summary: React to leave a wooden double of yourself to take a hit for you.

Wooden Fists.summary: Turn your hands into tree trunks.

Word of Freedom.summary: You utter a liberating word of power that frees a creature.

Word of Revision.summary: As all good writers know, you shouldn't kill off your protagonist before their story is complete.

Word of Truth.summary: You speak a statement that you believe to be true and that is free of any attempt to deceive through twisting words, omission, and so on.

Wordsmith.summary: You're a devotee of knowledge with an unmatched command of the language used to spread that knowledge.

Worm's Repast.summary: Gnawing worms materialize within the flesh of the target creature.

Wrathful Storm.summary: Create and control a massive storm.

Wronged Monk's Wrath.summary: You unleash your ki as a powerful storm of force and lightning.

Wyvern Sting.summary: You duplicate the venomous sting of a wyvern.

Ymeri's Mark.summary: Curse a creature with the Queen of the Inferno's mark to track it or make it explode.

You're Mine.summary: You manipulate the target's emotions, potentially allowing you to control it for a brief instant.

Zeal for Battle.summary: You stoke the righteous anger within yourself and an ally.

Zealous Conviction.summary: Instill unshakable conviction and zeal in willing creatures.

Zenith Star.summary: You call a tiny star to orbit a creature in a sparkling halo before shooting up into the heavens, where it marks the creature's rough location.

Zephyr Slip.summary: React to fly away from a creature.

Zone of Truth.summary: Designate an area where creatures are compelled to be truthful.
